# Resilience Checklist: ISK-0005 — Coordination & Redis Capability Contracts

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for declared consistency, topology, the capability check, single-instance verification, outage classification, and health are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Declared Consistency

- [x] CHK001 - Is each consistency level defined by what it guarantees and loses on coordinator restart or failover, and is their order stated? [Clarity, Spec §TR-4, Contract §Consistency 1]
- [x] CHK002 - Is every coordinator's declared level per primitive fixed in one table, with a reason for each Redis level? [Completeness, Contract §Consistency 2, Research R9]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the rule "declare the weaker level when in doubt" stated, and is it applied where Redis cannot prove fencing? [Consistency, Spec §TR-4, Research R9]

## Topology and the Capability Check

- [x] CHK004 - Is the undeclared topology defined as `multi_replica`, with the reason? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §TR-6]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the checker's rule order fixed, so every combination of inputs gives exactly one result and reason? [Completeness, Contract §Requirements 3, Research R5]
- [x] CHK006 - Is a malformed set of requirements defined, with its error and the time it is detected? [Edge Case, Contract §Requirements 4]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the combination table that SC-002 measures defined in terms of its dimensions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Tasks T018]
- [x] CHK008 - Is it stated that a refused feature never runs on weaker guarantees and never falls back to a local substitute, for every call and not only at start-up? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Requirements 5]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the boundary with ISK-0007 (mapping refusals onto start-up failure and readiness) stated, with its assumption? [Dependency, Spec §TR-7, §AV-4]

## Single-Instance Verification

- [x] CHK010 - Are the instance lease's name, scope, renewal cadence, and states specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007a, Contract §Requirements 6, Research R14]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the effect of a lost instance lease defined, including on a call already past the gate? [Edge Case, Contract §Requirements 6]
  - Settled in `checklist`: the gate checks before each call, so a call already past it completes.
- [x] CHK012 - Is the unverified case without PostgreSQL stated as a known limit and reported, rather than silently accepted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a, Contract §Known limits]

## Outage Behavior and Classification

- [x] CHK013 - Is each feature's outage behavior declared by the feature, with `degrade` named by a safe signal? [Completeness, Spec §TR-5, Contract §Requirements 1]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the unknown-outcome marker defined, with when it is set and the rule that nothing retries it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Contract §Failures 3, Research R11]
- [x] CHK015 - Is precedence between timeout and cancellation defined when both could apply? [Ambiguity, Contract §Failures 4]
  - Settled in `checklist`: as ISK-0004 research R7 decides.
- [x] CHK016 - Are a passed deadline and a cancelled wait defined, each with its code and no I/O or no lease held? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 - Are Redis failover, a read-only replica, a stopped server, and a paused server each mapped to a class and a health reason? [Coverage, Contract §Failures 2, §Health 2, Tasks T033, T038]
- [x] CHK018 - Is it stated that a cache outage costs only a miss, while a lost invalidation is visible to its caller? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Contract §Versioned cache 3]

## Health

- [x] CHK019 - Are the health reasons a closed set, each with status, trigger, and operator action? [Completeness, Contract §Health 2]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the probe's time bound stated as a safety bound, and its exclusion from liveness stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Contract §Health 1]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the order in which multiple coordinators are probed, and which result is reported, defined? [Clarity, Contract §Health 1]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the behavior of a production Redis coordinator with no credential provider (until ISK-0021) stated? [Edge Case, Contract §Credentials 2]

## Recovery and Test Environment

- [x] CHK023 - Is the `coordination` migration's reverse defined as data-losing and confirmation-gated, under ISK-0004's rules? [Completeness, Tasks T013, Persistence contract v2 §Migrations]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the outcome without a container runtime defined, locally and in CI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK025 - Is it stated what happens if the runner cannot pause a container, so fault tests are never skipped silently? [Edge Case, Plan §Risks, Tasks T033]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
